idea-plugin.name: Remote Flow
idea-plugin.description:
Remote Flow — Lightweight Remote Server Development & Execution Gateway

Remote Flow is an ultra-fast, zero-overhead remote server development plugin for IntelliJ IDEA developed by Murodjon. It enables you to write code locally on your fast machine (Windows, macOS, or Linux) with full IDE responsiveness while seamlessly synchronizing, building, running, debugging, and monitoring applications directly on remote Linux servers or cloud instances via secure SSH.

⚡ Zero Headless IDE Overhead

Traditional remote development tools (such as JetBrains Gateway or headless remote IDE backends) run a full IntelliJ instance on the remote server, consuming 2 GB to 4 GB of RAM and causing UI input lag over remote networks. Remote Flow eliminates this overhead: your local IDE stays responsive, while the server runs only your application, saving server memory and computational resources.

🚀 Core Features

  • Native Run Configuration Support: Full integration with IntelliJ Run/Debug Configurations (Remote Flow) to run and debug applications directly on the remote server using standard IDE buttons.
  • Smart Run Delegation: Optionally delegate standard IntelliJ Run (Shift + F10) and Debug (Shift + F9) actions to automatically execute on the active remote server with automatic port forwarding.
  • Differential Code Synchronization: Fast Rsync and SSH SFTP sync engines with intelligent ignore patterns (.git, .gradle, build, target, out, .idea, node_modules). Supports Auto-Sync on Save (Ctrl + S) and targeted right-click sync for individual files or directories.
  • One-Click Remote JVM Debugging: Automatically forwards JVM debug port 5005 and attaches IntelliJ's native debugger as soon as the remote application starts.
  • Bi-Directional SSH Port Forwarding: Forward remote web apps and databases directly to localhost (e.g. App 8080, PostgreSQL 5432, MySQL 3306, Redis 6379, RabbitMQ 5672/15672, MongoDB 27017, Vite 5173). Supports both Local → Host and Host → Local tunnels.
  • Automated Remote Port Scanner: Automatically scans active listening sockets (ss / netstat) on the remote server, categorizes services with friendly icons, and enables instant one-click tunnel creation.
  • Hardware Resource Monitor & Remote Task Manager: Real-time CPU, RAM, and Disk metrics in the IntelliJ Status Bar. Interactive task manager to view running Linux processes and terminate hung tasks.
  • Remote File Explorer & Configuration Manager: Browse remote directories, upload files, create folders, and safely edit remote .env and application.yml configs with automatic backups (.bak).
  • Unified Log Console & SSH Terminal: Colorized ANSI log tool window with category filters (ALL, RUN, SYNC, SSH, SYSTEM), search, pause, export, plus embedded interactive SSH terminal tabs.
  • Multi-Server Profiles & Watchdog: Manage Dev, Staging, and Cloud servers with Password or SSH Private Key (.pem, id_rsa) authentication and auto-reconnect watchdog.

⌨️ Default Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Alt + Shift + R: Remote Run
  • Alt + Shift + D: Remote Debug (Port 5005)
  • Alt + Shift + S: Remote Stop
  • Alt + Shift + U: Fast Sync Project to Server
  • Alt + Shift + L: Open Remote Flow Log Window
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.0

  • Run Configuration Integration: Added native Remote Flow Run Configuration for seamless execution via standard IDE controls.
  • Standard Run Delegation: Added RemoteFlowProgramRunner to route standard IDE Run/Debug actions (Shift + F10 / Shift + F9) directly to the active remote server.
  • Bi-Directional Port Forwarding: Added support for Local → Host and Host → Local SSH tunnels.
  • Active Listening Port Scanner: Added automatic remote port scanner with service detection (Postgres, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Spring Boot, etc.).
  • Differential Sync: Added Rsync auto-detection, SSH SFTP engine, smart exclude patterns, Auto-Sync on Save (Ctrl + S), and targeted right-click file sync.
  • JVM Remote Debugger: Added automated port 5005 tunnel creation and debugger attachment.
  • Remote File Browser & Config Editor: Added remote file tree explorer and safe .env / application.yml editor with backup creation.
  • Hardware Monitor & Task Manager: Added real-time CPU, RAM, and Disk metrics to Status Bar widget and interactive Remote Task Manager dialog.
  • Unified Log Window: Added colorized ANSI console with categorized filtering and log export.
